Keep data scrapers, pipelines, and scheduled client reports executing 24/7 in dedicated cloud environments even when your local power drops.
Coordinate multi-bot Telegram groups to triage support tickets, track logistics consignments across Durban harbours, and draft replies in parallel.

Integrate Telegram, Gmail, Notion, and your databases to assemble custom specialist teams.
Schedule recurring jobs, run code, or delegate live browser research whenever you need.

chapters.d: While stuck in Sandton traffic, your bot reviews overnight emails, flags urgent supplier queries, and sends a concise briefing to Telegram.
Your agent scours local market listings and competitor catalogues using its cloud browser, compiling pricing comparisons directly into Google Sheets.
A dedicated coding bot scripts a backend endpoint, runs automated tests in its isolated cloud instance, and commits the finished code to GitHub.
As evening arrives and local devices go offline, your bots keep processing datasets, monitoring crypto markets, and scheduling morning agendas.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost in South Africa and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers billed in USD: Plus at $20/month, Pro at $60/month, and Ultra at $120/month. Every plan starts with a 3-day free trial granting up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a card is linked upon signup and charged only when the trial ends unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do Ceyo bots continue working if my phone or computer is offline?
faq.a: Yes. Every bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer in the data centre, which means load shedding, power interruptions, or disconnected devices will never stop your running tasks, routines, or code.

faq.q: Can I manage Ceyo bots through Telegram?
faq.a: Absolutely. You can chat one-on-one with your bots or invite several agents into a Telegram group where they collaborate as a specialised team, handling research, coding, and scheduling together.

faq.q: Which languages and regional contexts do the bots understand?
faq.a: Ceyo agents support English, Afrikaans, isiZulu, isiXhosa, and dozens of international languages. They can research local portals, parse regional documentation, and converse naturally in text or voice calls.

faq.q: How secure is my data and cloud computer environment?
faq.a: Each agent operates inside a sandboxed, isolated cloud virtual environment. Your shared documents, long-term memory, built-in crypto wallet, and connected accounts remain protected by stringent isolation protocols.
